definition: A parameter C : (World → Prop) → World → Prop. C(P,w) says P is conceivable at w in the stipulated test. No closure, factivity, bridge, or introspection is built in. In particular describing MC or ¬H does not supply C(MC) or C(¬H).
note: Issue #248 analytical vocabulary, scoped to this test. A source endorsement would require a separate passage-specific claim; the existing I.3.3 claim supplies only the narrow reading.
